description: Stairville xBrick Quad 16x8W RGBW (16 quad-colour LEDs in 4 segments). Modes: 4CH, 6CH, 8CH, 16CH, 18CH; 18CH is the default. Generated from the Open Fixture Library (MIT licence, stairville/xbrick-quad-16x8w-rgbw at commit d9d675e) and checked against the manual.

modes.name: 8CH
modes.description: RGBW, Dimmer (unused), Strobe (unused), Function select (off), Program Speed (unused).

_note: Generated by tools/fixture_library.py (item 50). Corrections from the manual: 6CH Strobe: the manual prints 0 % to 100 % with no open range and OFL has none either; open = 0 is an assumption; 18CH Strobe: as 6CH: no open range in the manual or in OFL; open = 0 is an assumption. Not in the manual or not verified: in 8CH the RGBW channels only work with the function select at 0..4, dimmer and strobe only above 4, so the mode has no brightness control.
